title: Spanish Gold Towel Shelf, 24.7-Inch Wall-Mounted Brass 3-Tier Hotel Style Drying Rack, Allied Brass
description: Bathroom towel shelf with drying rack (hotel style train rack), brass construction, wall mount / wall-mounted installation with concealed screw mounting for a clean traditional look — available in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. Size: 24.7 inches long (24.7-inch, 24.7 in) x 10.4 inches high (10.4-inch, 10.4 in) x 8.9 inches wide (8.9-inch, 8.9 in); projection 3.5 inches (3.5-inch, 3.5 in). Use as a towel shelf, towel rack, towel holder, or bathroom towel rack to store folded towels on the top shelf and hang towels on the lower drying rack. Includes towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware; easy installation with included mounting hardware. Some assembly required. Product weight 5.6 lb; shipping weight 7 lb. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Ideal for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass.
